items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1960-11-30
items.q: Little Cartwright was on his record.

ctx.x: It picked it up. Dick Allen. We're gonna play you a little Don Albert record first. And, if you could tell us something about it. Okay. This is rockin' and swingin', huh? Rockin' and swingin'. Yeah. Little Cartwright was on his record. Mm-hmm. Quirbill Hall. Did you change much on the records? The band, did you change at all? Different guys come in? Well, later years we started losing a couple. No, not on this record, yeah.
No, I mean you had the same men.
